active_initiative: Queue Project Memory validation hardening, branch fix/queue-project-memory-auto-repair, based on main at the merge of PR #105. Task 003 (Competitor Observation Engine) was the queue's first real, live, multi-task run: it fully implemented its scoped work and fully updated CURRENT_STATUS.md/STATUS.json/HANDOFF.md/ROADMAP.md in one commit (8261a20), then committed, pushed, and opened a real PR (#107) -- exactly as its own injected prompt instructed. run-queue.ts's own post-task check then failed it anyway: 'no project-memory update'. Root cause: the check (git status --porcelain, uncommitted-only) never saw the change because it was already committed -- a detection bug, not a real omission, proven directly from git show --stat, gh pr view 107, and the agent's own is_error:false report. Fix: scripts/ai/projectMemory.ts detects a real update whether committed or not (union of commits-since-branch-point and uncommitted diff), rejects trivial/timestamp-only/conflict-marker/invalid-JSON changes, and adds a bounded auto-repair loop reusing max_repair_attempts. Commit/push/PR steps made idempotent. A permanent reconcileFailedMemoryChecks recovery path (reconcile.ts) handles any future recurrence. A related pre-existing bug (finalizeCompletionState's multi-line commit messages losing newlines through a shell) was found live during recovery and fixed alongside it. Task 003 itself was recovered without redoing any work -- only its QUEUE_STATUS.json completion state was corrected via the existing finalizeCompletionState() path; PR #107 (product work) is untouched and independent of this branch. See DECISIONS.md ADR-0017.
